title: True action finds the inward door
summary: The line gives purpose back to the day by refusing drift its usual authority. Keep this close: Let this stay with you: let praise, saintly company, and true action soften the self into homecoming.
takeaway: Use this day for what can still remain.
lifeApplication: Before drifting into another task, choose one act that treats life as opportunity for meeting, service, or honest return.
